metadata.title: Exotic S^2 x S^2 candidates that are just fake
metadata.abstract: We show that two infinite families of homology $S^2\times S^2$'s presented in \cite{FPS, AP}, originally proposed as exotic candidates, are aspherical. In particular, none of these manifolds is an exotic $S^2\times S^2$. We prove this by reconstructing them from aspherical building blocks, following Edmonds. The same arguments apply to and rule out further candidates for simply connected exotica.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 排除假的 exotic S²×S² 候选
analysis.workSummary: 将两类既有 homology S²×S² 候选重构为 aspherical building blocks，证明其 aspherical，因而均不是 exotic S²×S²；方法还排除其他单连通候选。
analysis.breakthrough: 纠正此前 exotic 候选的拓扑识别，给出可推广的排除手段。
analysis.limitations: 只排除指定家族，不证明 exotic S²×S² 不存在。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 用于制图和最终编辑。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.04634v1 · PDF 第 2 页，致谢
